HEADER.TITLE: Ministry of Health's World of Data

POSITIVE_TESTS.TITLE: Percentage of positive tests yesterday
POSITIVE_TESTS.TESTED_YESTERDAY: Individuals tested for the virus yesterday

FILTERS.COUNT_IN_AGE: Number of confirmed in age group
FILTERS.PERCENT_IN_AGE: Percentage of total confirmed in age group

TOOLTIP.A: Number of COVID-19 cases detected from 00:00 to 23:59 yesterday.
TOOLTIP.B: Total: Cumulative number of confirmed cases since the outbreak, including reinfections.
TOOLTIP.C: Confirmed cases: Individuals who were tested and found positive for COVID-19 via PCR or supervised antigen test (starting from Jan 5, 2022), regardless of symptoms, clinical status, recovery, or mortality.
TOOLTIP.D: The confirmed cases index is affected by the number of institutional tests performed and therefore may not reflect actual morbidity levels.

TOOLTIP.A: Number of active COVID-19 cases as of the latest update.
TOOLTIP.B: Active cases: Individuals who were tested and found positive for COVID-19 via PCR or supervised antigen test (starting from Jan 5, 2022), regardless of symptoms, who have not yet been defined as recovered and have not passed away.

TOOLTIP.A: Number of vaccine recipients against COVID-19 since the beginning of the vaccination campaign. Does not include the 2023/2024 winter vaccines.
Cumulative number of deaths from COVID-19 since the outbreak.
TOOLTIP.B: Death data is updated after verifying death certificates for cause of death, therefore late updates may occur.

TOOLTIP.A: Percentage of individuals who tested positive for COVID-19 out of the number of individuals tested yesterday.
TOOLTIP.B: Individuals tested for the virus yesterday: Number of tests for initial detection (excluding follow-up recovery tests) via PCR or supervised antigen, performed and resulted between 00:00 and 23:59 yesterday.
TOOLTIP.C: Total tests yesterday: Total number of COVID-19 test results (PCR or antigen), including both initial diagnostic tests and follow-up recovery tests, received between 00:00 and 23:59 yesterday.

TOOLTIP.A: Number of confirmed COVID-19 cases detected in the last 7 days (excluding the update day) and the percentage change compared to the previous 7 days.
TOOLTIP.B: The confirmed cases index is affected by the number of institutional tests performed and therefore may not reflect actual morbidity levels.

TOOLTIP.A: Number of deaths from COVID-19 in the last 7 days (excluding the update day) and the percentage change compared to the previous 7 days.
Number of individuals tested for COVID-19 via PCR or antigen in the last 7 days (excluding the update day) and the percentage change compared to the previous 7 days.
TOOLTIP.B: Data does not include individuals in follow-up recovery tests.
TOOLTIP.C: Positive tested: Percentage of individuals found positive for COVID-19 out of the number of individuals tested for the virus in the last 7 days.

TOOLTIP.A: Daily average of new confirmed cases per week.
TOOLTIP.B: Confirmed cases: Individuals who were tested and found positive for COVID-19 via PCR or supervised antigen test (starting from Jan 5, 2022), regardless of symptoms, clinical status, recovery, or mortality.
TOOLTIP.C: The confirmed cases index is affected by the number of institutional tests performed and therefore may not reflect actual morbidity levels.

TOOLTIP.A: The daily number of COVID-19 infections and the 7-day moving average.
TOOLTIP.B: Confirmed cases: Individuals who were tested and found positive for COVID-19 via PCR or supervised antigen test (starting from Jan 5, 2022), regardless of symptoms, clinical status, recovery, or mortality.
TOOLTIP.C: The confirmed cases index is affected by the number of institutional tests performed and therefore may not reflect actual morbidity levels.

CHILD_MORBIDITY_TOOLTIP.A: Daily average of confirmed cases under 19
CHILD_MORBIDITY_TOOLTIP.B: The daily average number of confirmed cases under 19 in the last 7 days, divided by 4 age groups: 0-4, 5-11, 12-15, 16-19. Confirmed cases - individuals tested positive for COVID-19 via PCR or supervised antigen test, regardless of symptoms, clinical status, recovery, or mortality.
CHILD_MORBIDITY_TOOLTIP.C: The confirmed cases index is affected by the number of institutional tests performed and therefore may not reflect actual morbidity levels.
